finding: The prevalence of HPV infection in mothers was 28.14%-30.37%, with a perinatal transmission frequency of 21.05%-21.95% at birth, and HPV positive infants cleared the infection within 6 weeks.
mod_finding: Cesarean section did not protect the infants against perinatal HPV transmission.
followup_time: 1 year for mothers, 6 months for babies
